disclaimer: NOT r.avaflow: flow depths, velocities and arrival times come from serac-swe-voellmy v0.2.0, a single-phase depth-averaged Voellmy-Salm solver implemented in this repository. r.avaflow could not be obtained (see infra/docker/ravaflow/README.md); cross-validation against r.avaflow is outstanding.
label: cascade rules v0
note: Deposit depths are the ensemble median and 95th percentile per chainage bin, not a single member. The index is evaluated at the median and the breach and surge at the 95th percentile, so the surge numbers are an upper case rather than a central one.
resolution_limitation: 30 m DEM: the Bhote Koshi gorge is under 60 m wide in places, so it spans fewer than two cells. Superelevation, run-up on valley walls and channel blocking are unresolved; damming numbers derived from deposit depth against channel geometry are order-of-magnitude indicators, not engineering estimates.

assumptions: Damming index v0 = deposit depth / channel depth at a constriction, both measured on the same 30 m DEM. It is a dimensionless indicator, not a probability derived from data: no inventory of landslide dams exists for this corridor. Channel width defaults to 60 m -- a stated value, not a survey -- wherever no measured cross-section is supplied.

30 m DEM: the Bhote Koshi gorge is under 60 m wide in places, so it spans fewer than two cells. Superelevation, run-up on valley walls and channel blocking are unresolved; damming numbers derived from deposit depth against channel geometry are order-of-magnitude indicators, not engineering estimates.

Breach hydrograph v0 is a parametric triangular wave: peak discharge from a published-form regression Qp = k * (V_lake * H_dam)^a with k and a stated below, rise time one third of the total, no routing, no sediment, no progressive erosion. It is a shape, not a breach model.

30 m DEM: the Bhote Koshi gorge is under 60 m wide in places, so it spans fewer than two cells.
